seoPage.title: EV Maintenance Explained — What Still Needs Care in India | EVSavari
seoPage.metaDescription: EV Maintenance Explained — What Still Needs Care in India — practical ownership guidance for Indian buyers.
seoPage.intro: EV maintenance is often described as ‘zero service’. In reality, fewer engine items exist — but tyres, brakes, filters, coolant, and software updates still matter for safe ownership.

editorialSections.title: What changes vs petrol
paragraphs: You generally skip oil changes and exhaust-related parts. The battery and motor still need monitoring through service schedules and warnings.

editorialSections.title: Practical service checklist
bullets: Tyre rotation and alignment — EV weight affects wear.
Brake fluid and pads — regen reduces use but does not eliminate service.
Cabin filter and wiper care — especially before monsoon.
Software updates — follow brand guidance at authorised centres.

editorialSections.title: Ownership realism
paragraphs: Service network coverage in your city still matters — especially for warranty claims and high-voltage checks.

misconceptions.myth: Any workshop can service high-voltage systems
misconceptions.reality: Use authorised networks for battery-related work.

faq.question: How often should I service an EV?
faq.answer: Follow the brand schedule — often annual or km-based, lighter than many petrol cars.

faq.question: Are brakes cheaper?
faq.answer: Often slower wear due to regen — still inspect regularly.

faq.question: Does battery need ‘service’?
faq.answer: Health checks may be recommended — read warranty terms.

faq.question: Monsoon preparation?
faq.answer: See monsoon driving guide for range and safety habits.
